President.name: Lakshita Madhavan
President.description: Leads the E-Board and presides over all meetings. Main contact for university administration and faculty advisors, oversees planning of flagship events like GirlHacks and the WiCS Gala, and leads E-Board recruitment and transition with the VP.

Vice President.name: Stephanie Nicolaescu
Vice President.description: Right-hand to the President and steps in when they are absent. Oversees the committee system, checks in with E-Board members, and coordinates end-of-semester reporting and goal-setting.

Secretary.name: Anne Therese Argonza
Secretary.description: Keeps records and communication organized: meeting minutes, action items, attendance, biweekly newsletters, the Discord server, and Highlander Hub postings. Monitors the official WiCS email, forwards inquiries to the right member, and follows up after 3 days.

Treasurer.name: Sharanya Raj
Treasurer.description: Owns the club's finances: drafts budgets, submits funding requests to Student Senate, processes reimbursements, and gives monthly financial reports. Tracks sponsorship funds with Industry Partnerships and buys event materials with Event Coordinators at least 3 weeks ahead.

Industry Partnership1.name: Carlin Verano
Industry Partnership1.description: Builds relationships with companies to secure sponsorships, company tours and recruiter events. Maintains the industry contact database and GirlHacks sponsorship prospectus, liaises with the YWCC GirlHacks advisor, and holds a 72-hour response standard with partners.

PR1.name: Azka Faisal
PR1.description: Manages the WiCS brand and social media (Instagram, Discord, LinkedIn), designs flyers, posters and merch, runs marketing campaigns, and captures photos and recaps at events. Runs weekly PR Committee meetings.

PR2.name: Caithy Liao
PR2.description: Manages the WiCS brand and social media (Instagram, Discord, LinkedIn), designs flyers, posters and merch, runs marketing campaigns, and captures photos and recaps at events. Runs weekly PR Committee meetings.

Event Co-ordinator1.name: Garima Thapa
Event Co-ordinator1.description: Plans and runs WiCS events: OSIL registration, room bookings, supply and catering orders, office inventory, and day-of logistics, including GirlHacks and the WiCS Gala. Runs weekly Events Committee meetings.

Event Co-ordinator2.name: Saidarsha Karunakaran
Event Co-ordinator2.description: Plans and runs WiCS events: OSIL registration, room bookings, supply and catering orders, office inventory, and day-of logistics, including GirlHacks and the WiCS Gala. Runs weekly Events Committee meetings.

Technical Director.name: Meera James
Technical Director.description: Leads at least 2 technical workshops per semester, maintains the WiCS website, Discord server and Linktree, builds the GirlHacks website, and provides tech support during workshops and GirlHacks.

Industry Partnership2.name: Manisha Suresh
Industry Partnership2.description: Builds relationships with companies to secure sponsorships, company tours and recruiter events. Maintains the industry contact database and GirlHacks sponsorship prospectus, liaises with the YWCC GirlHacks advisor, and holds a 72-hour response standard with partners.

Membership chair.name: Diya Pottangadi
Membership chair.description: Recruits and retains members: leads recruitment at involvement fairs, maintains the membership database and attendance, sends welcome emails, and organizes social events, Lounge Hours and study groups. Manages the Discord opportunities channel.

Community Outreach.name: Priya Patel
Community Outreach.description: Connects WiCS with campus and the wider community: coordinates collaborations with other clubs, secures speakers, runs alumni relations and mentorship chats, leads tabling, and recruits GirlHacks judges, volunteers and mentors.
